note: Plumas NF campground on the southeast shore of Lake Davis (Beckwourth RD), in loops over a pine slope above the lake; many sites look out over the water. Paved roads and pads, two vehicles and six people a site. Next to the Honker Cove boat launch; an RV dump is nearby. No bear lockers. Operated by a concessionaire. --Claude
summary: Grasshopper Flat (Plumas): $38, +$5 extra vehicle, 71 sites (33 reservable, group 69/70), first-come after Labor Day, 14 days; flush toilets, coin showers, water (FS amenity line says none); lakeview kept (shore row 016-018 on a bench 4-6 m above the water).
